defects.defect: Section 4 says to keep 'the inactive Working' value in CaseStatus. Describe does not return Working at all, even as inactive, and CaseStatus has no such row. The only evidence is 2 Case rows holding 'Working', which is consistent with a deleted value. Calling it an inactive value in the set is unverified and presented as fact.
defects.skill_gap: None exists: no instruction to separate 'value present in data' from 'value present in the value set' for picklists.

defects.defect: Section 6 reuses an AskCoworker list of permission sets with Case Edit without re-querying it. The list is labelled 'reported by AskCoworker' and is correct (verified), but it is a small subset of the 30 non-profile permission sets with Case Edit.
defects.skill_gap: None exists: no guidance on marking a reported list as partial.
